caption: The drawing consists of two outlined objects positioned vertically in the center of the page, depicted with thin black lines on a beige background. Both objects resemble flat shoes viewed from above, each elongated with a squared toe. The left shoe features a simple, unadorned design with long, loosely depicted ties extending outward from each side. The right shoe is similar in shape but includes a detailed cluster of small, rounded shapes resembling a textured or floral embellishment at the toe area; this shoe also has long, loosely depicted ties extending outward from each side. The overall composition is sparse, with the shoes centered and ample empty space surrounding them.
title: Slipper
